tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All hematological parameters are within normal limits except for a markedly elevated platelet distribution width, which may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly due to platelet activation or a reactive process. No evidence of anemia, leukocytosis, or thrombocytopenia. Correlation with clinical context is recommended.
